caseNameFull: John C. Fetzer, Receivers, etc. v. David A. Kohn and John C. Fetzer, Receivers, etc. v. Jacob Miller

opinions.text: May 31, 1904. Petitions for writs of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied. Mr. Jno. S. Miller, Mr. Henry Crawford and Mr. Charles H. Aldrich for petitioners. Mr. Thomas A. Moran and Mr. Levy Mayer for respondents in No. 697. Mr. Horace K. Tenney and Mr. Henry R. Platt for respondents in No. 698.
